Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You give your companion a few precise words, then point out the place their next step should land.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One ally within 3 squares that can hear and understand your Aid.
Duration
Movement is immediate; Aid lasts until used or the start of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
The movement benefit can be granted once on your turn.
Type
Signature

Your Aid can reach that ally. When you give Aid, the ally may also move 1 square without provoking before making the aided roll. This movement uses no ally action or movement allowance. Aid’s Boon and expiry are unchanged.

Additional rulings
